versions.changelog: Each user chooses whether album, book and audiobook covers in their title cards are cropped to fill their tiles (Settings > Display > Crop covers to fill their tiles with File Transformation, or per user on the plugin's settings page); both versions of a card show the same covers. The server-wide crop setting becomes the default for users who haven't chosen. The settings page is listed under Plugins in the dashboard's side menu. The first start rebuilds every card once.

Each user chooses whether they see title cards or Jellyfin's own library images (Settings > Display > Show title cards with File Transformation, or per user on the plugin's settings page); the choice applies in every app, including TV apps. Library images stay Jellyfin's and keep refreshing; cards saved into them by earlier versions are handed back on first start. New libraries get cards as soon as they're scanned. "Keep text out from behind the title" is now "Exclude text from behind the title".
Audiobooks stored as one file per chapter use their book folder's cover, so the card shows different books instead of repeating one cover; no image is used twice on a card.

Playlist cards use the art behind the playlists' contents (artist backdrops, album covers, series, movies) instead of Jellyfin's mosaic images. New setting: crop square and portrait art (album, book and audiobook covers) to fill its tile, off by default.
Title characters the server's font lacks (e.g. Japanese) are drawn in another installed font that has them; characters no font has are logged.
First public release: collage title cards for every home-screen library, Live TV and recordings, grouped views; text filter on Linux x64/ARM64.

name: Title Cards
description: Builds each home-screen library image as a collage of that library's own artwork, with the library name drawn the way Jellyfin draws it. Covers every library, Live TV, recordings and grouped views, refreshes nightly, and keeps logos and lettering out from behind the title (text detection on Linux x64/ARM64).
overview: Collage title cards for every home-screen library
